author: Unity
description:
Introducing the official Unity plugin for Grok Build - bringing our engineering guidance directly to your terminal in our continued effort to meet you where you work.

Instead of configuring tools yourself, one command in your terminal delivers:
✅ 30+ Unity Skills: Written by Unity feature teams covering UI Toolkit, URP, Shader Graph, Physics, LevelPlay, and Localization.
✅ Unity CLI Workflows: Drive a running Unity Editor and build and test through the Unity CLI, which the agent installs when needed.
✅ Unity 6+ Compatibility: Works right out of the box with Unity 6 and above with nothing to copy across when moving to a new machine.

One install, no manual setup, built by Unity.

🔗 Get started: https://on.unity.com/GrokPlugin
